view.text: Complete twenty-term reduced H6 pilot on two raw TT directions. The mixed coefficient is provisional until an independent full-functional reference is checked. This is a classical input to the pending four-point loop; physical large-rank limits and microscopic corner dynamics remain open. Error diagnostics are not rigorous certificates.
